categories.name: Model specification and predictor transforms
categories.definition: A decision that fixes what is estimated — the model family, the terms and interactions tested, or how predictors are transformed before fitting.
categories.criterion: if the choice changes the estimand or hypothesis being tested it belongs here, not with numerical convergence aids

categories.name: Convergence coaxing
categories.definition: A numerical fitting aid — optimizer choice, starting values, or iteration/tolerance limits — meant only to make the same fit converge, not to change what it estimates.
categories.criterion: if it affects only whether or how fast estimation succeeds, leaving the estimand intact, it lands here

categories.name: Column pruning
categories.definition: Restricting the working data to a fixed subset of columns and silently discarding the rest before downstream steps.
categories.criterion: if the operation drops fields from a single table without combining sources, it is pruning rather than a join

categories.name: Table assembly and relabeling
categories.definition: Merging two data sources into one analysis table on a shared key and renaming the combined columns.
categories.criterion: if records from separate sources are matched and stitched together it is a join, even if columns are also renamed

categories.name: Ingestion representation
categories.definition: Choosing how raw data is loaded into memory — the parsing path and in-memory type — rather than what is kept or estimated.
categories.criterion: if the decision concerns the reader/container that first materializes the raw rows, it belongs here
